title: Star Wars Trilogy VHS Box Set Digitally Mastered 1995 Lucasfilms Lucas
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in the Star Wars universe with this Trilogy VHS Box Set. This set includes all three original films in the series, digitally mastered for superior picture and sound quality. Follow the adventures of Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia as they embark on a thrilling sci-fi and fantasy journey. 

With a PG rating, this box set is suitable for all ages and features English language, Harrison Ford, Mark Hamill, and other beloved actors. This edition is a must-have for any Star Wars fan and is perfect for collectors or those looking to relive the magic of the original trilogy.
